Description:
This hotel is located in the northeastern part of Shanghai. The world-famous shopping streets, Nanjing Road and Huaihai Road are 20 minutes away. The centre of the city (People's Square) is just a 15-minute drive away and it is 30 minutes by car to Shanghai Stadium. Hangzhou is a 2-hour drive away.

The hotel was opened in 1992 and comprises a total of 418 guest rooms including 120 luxury rooms, which are located on the newly-furnished luxury floors and 190 standard rooms, famous for their roominess and comfort, which reflect the overall style of the hotel. This establishment is ideal for both holidaymakers and business travellers alike and facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-in/check out service. Guest are offered a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom, 6 lifts, a café, a newspaper stand and a hairdressing salon. There is a bar, a games room, a TV lounge, 3 Chinese and western restaurants, 9 business meeting rooms and WLAN/Internet access (charges apply). Guests may also take advantage of the room and laundry services for an additional fee. Parking and a garage are available for those arriving by car.

All rooms come with Internet access and a minibar, as well as a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, an ironing set, a king-size or double bed, centrally regulated air conditioning and heating and a safe are provided in all accommodation as standard.

The hotel features a 5th floor health centre which is equipped with a sauna (charges apply), a massage room, a spa pool (charges apply) and a steam bath. For an extra fee guests can use the hotel's indoor badminton practice court and table tennis room. Charges also apply to the use of the hotel's indoor basketball court and billiards room. Sports enthusiasts may also enjoy a workout in the gym.

Description:
Enjoy Chinese culture, excellent service and the convenience of a central location at the first Garden Boutique Hotel in Shanghai, located in the heart of downtown.

Our 5 stars hotel in Shanghai was built in 1934; the building was designed for the family of the famous architect I.M. Pei (Louvre Pyramid, Paris). PEI Mansion hotel embraces the strong passion the powerful Pei family had and, like a themed mansion, maintains a combination of culture, style and history within this unique city center hotel. The exceptional and thoughtful design within the interior of this City Heritage building has resulted in a hotel of uncompromising style and beauty.

It is a luxurious oasis set in middle of downtown Shanghai, a 5 star hotel with a peaceful haven of immaculate manicured gardens and spectacular ponds filled with Japanese Coy. A magnificent spiraling Dragon staircase with its stunning original glass ceiling, leads from the lavishly adorned lobby, to floors filled with memorabilia of Shanghais golden 1930s. Some prized artifacts from old China include: an original 1900s stone Gazebo & a tablet with long life written in 100 different Chinese characters among other items. Built in 1934, Pei Mansion Hotel in Shanghais Jingan District was the former family home of the celebrated architect, I.M. Pei. Now a modern boutique hotel, it features stylish rooms with free Wi-Fi and personalised 24-hour butler services.

Decorated with authentic Chinese crafts and antiques, the spacious air-conditioned rooms all come with a minibar and tea/coffee making facilities. Bathrooms have a separate rainshower and a spa bathtub.

Pei Mansion Hotel is a 10-minute walk from Metro Line 2 and 7 at Jingan Temple Station. It is within 5 km from People Square, East Nanjing Road and the scenic Bund. Hongqiao International Airport is 12 km away.

Guests can enjoy a stroll in the landscaped gardens and visit the peaceful koi pond. The hotel can arrange for relaxing in-room spa treatments. A 24-hour business centre and housekeeping services are provided.

Boasting 7 private dining rooms, Xin Rong Ji Chinese Restaurant serves delicious Shanghainese and Cantonese dishes. The rooftop Western restaurant has a bar and overlooks the beautiful city. Drinks can also be enjoyed at the Garden Bar. Guests are required to show a valid government-issued ID card or passport upon check-in.
